questions.title: UPSC Editorial Analysis: 18th BRICS Summit
questions.subject: ir
questions.q: With reference to “UPSC Editorial Analysis: 18th BRICS Summit”, consider the following statements:
items: General Studies-2; Topic: Bilateral, regional and global groupings and agreements involving India and/or affecting India’s interests.
The summit concluded with the unanimous adoption of … General Studies-2; Topic: Bilateral, regional and global groupings and agreements involving India and/or affecting India’s interests.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct.
